map.即便一年只跑 3000 km，机油满 12 个月也应更换：机油在使用中会氧化、吸: Even covering only 3000 km a year, oil should still be changed at 12 months: in service it oxidizes, absorbs moisture and uses up additives, changes tied to time rather than mileage. Brake fluid is hygroscopic, and rising water content cuts the boiling point sharply, which can cause vapour lock under repeated braking, so the time interval matters more than mileage.
map.长期停放时建议每 2 周启动一次并运行至水温正常，为电瓶补电并驱除潮气；每月移动: In long-term storage, start the engine every 2 weeks and run it to normal coolant temperature to recharge the battery and drive out damp; move the car monthly so the tires do not develop flat spots; keep pressure slightly above standard to limit deformation; fill the tank before storage to reduce condensation. Beyond 3 months, disconnect the negative terminal or connect a maintenance charger.
map.💡 双阈值取先到者：里程与时间任一到期即需施工。本表为通用参考，实际以随车保养手: 💡 Dual thresholds take whichever comes first: either mileage or time reaching due means the job must be done. This table is a general reference; follow the vehicle service manual.
map.低里程车辆按月份而非里程安排保养，防止油液老化。: Plan maintenance by month rather than mileage for low-mileage vehicles so fluids do not age.
map.季节性换胎、防冻液、雨刮等按日历提醒，保障不同气候安全。: Set calendar reminders for seasonal tire changes, coolant and wipers to stay safe across climates.
map.长期停放车按时间检查电瓶、轮胎与油液。: Check the battery, tires and fluids of stored cars on a time basis.
map.低里程车的十项双阈值计划: Ten-item dual-threshold plan for a low-mileage car
map.当前里程 43000 km、车龄 4 年、上次保养距今 11 个月、年均行驶 9: A car at 43000 km, 4 years old, last serviced 11 months ago and averaging 9000 km a year: engine oil (10000 km / 12 months) still has 7000 km of mileage but only 1 month of time, and the air and cabin filters (20000 km / 12 months) likewise have a month left, so all three belong in one workshop visit. The fuel filter (40000 km / 24 months) and brake fluid have 13 months left, while coolant and battery have over 25 months, none yet due. Clearly low-mileage running is governed by time, and judging by mileage misleads badly.
map.不开为什么要保养？: Why service a car that is barely driven?
map.油液会吸湿、氧化、酸化，橡胶密封会老化，电瓶会自放电。按时间保养比按里程对低里程: Fluids absorb moisture, oxidize and acidify, rubber seals age and the battery self-discharges, so servicing by time matters more than by mileage for rarely used cars.
map.长期停放怎么护车？: How do I protect a car stored long-term?
map.满电断开负极或接维护充电器，胎压略高、遮光停放，定期启动升温除湿，避免刹车盘锈死: Charge it fully then disconnect the negative terminal or fit a maintenance charger, run slightly higher tire pressure and keep it out of the light, and start it regularly to warm the engine and drive off damp, avoiding rusted discs and a flat battery.
map.里程与时间双阈值取先到者；低里程用车以时间维度为主，实际以随车保养手册为准: Mileage and time both apply, whichever comes first; low-mileage use is governed mainly by time; follow the vehicle service manual in practice
